title: Figure 19: Known vs. Unknown Object Sightings by Number of Objects per Sighting, 1947–1952
description: Back-to-back horizontal bar chart comparing "Total Less Unknown" (left) with "Unknown" (right) object sightings, in percent, by number of objects seen: One, Two, Three to ten, Eleven or more and Not stated. Both axes run from 0 to 80 percent, and single-object sightings dominate both sides. Caption: "FIGURE 19 COMPARISON OF KNOWN AND UNKNOWN OBJECT SIGHTINGS BY NUMBER OF OBJECTS PER SIGHTING, 1947-1952"; drawing A-7497.
